scope: Existing IDs; ASCII exact-name and small batch samples only

features.observed: Last duplicate displayed; editing replaces all entries for that exact name; blank save retains empty record; restart verified
All/Newer overwritten files append duplicate descriptions; skip policies preserve target descriptions
All applies to two files, skip-all preserves two; Newer copies strictly newer and skips equal/older timestamp samples
File deletion removes duplicate descriptions for that name while preserving another file/comment
